captions.detailed: A 3D model of a wide-field short refractor telescope mounted on a manual single-arm alt-azimuth mount. The assembly stands on a three-legged spreader-bar tripod with light grey metallic legs and dark grey joints. The main central column is a thick grey cylinder supporting a dark grey azimuth rotating joint, which connects to a single-sided mounting arm. The telescope tube is light grey with a dark grey eyepiece assembly and a blue-tinted front lens, mounted to rotate vertically on the altitude axis of the side arm.
captions.instruction: Generate a 3D model of a wide-field refractor telescope on a manual alt-azimuth single-arm mount, including a three-legged tripod with spreader bars, a central vertical column, a rotating azimuth joint, a side arm, and a telescope tube that pivots vertically.
captions.factory: The code constructs the telescope by first creating the tripod base from thin cylinders rotated and positioned as legs, joined by horizontal spreader bars. A thick vertical cylinder forms the main column, topped with a larger cylindrical collar for the azimuth joint. The alt-azimuth arm is built using box and cylinder primitives, supporting a horizontal altitude pivot axis. Finally, the telescope tube is modeled as a compound shape of concentric cylinders with a tapered front, an eyepiece cylinder, and a lens disk, attached via a revolute joint to the side arm.
